request: Install and run https://github.com/steel-dev/steel-browser on the dyaus host for use from this BB environment, then create a new independently installable BB plugin in this repository that integrates Steel as the replacement browser infrastructure for the prior KERNEL.SH-based workflow. Keep the root orchestration-only conventions, align manifest/package/CLI/UI/docs/tests, avoid committing generated artifacts, and verify the Steel service plus the plugin's human UI and CLI surface.
message: Implemented project-scoped Steel bindings and engine policy, dedicated persistent profiles, compact square inline viewer with minimization, Tools configuration for Playwright/Jev/fallback, safe preflight-only fallback, and an opt-in Jev CDP adapter. Focused type, unit, build, desktop/mobile browser, live Playwright navigation, and cookie isolation/persistence checks passed; no paid Jev call was executed.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Keep Steel hosted on the connected dyaus machine as the primary host; do not move or duplicate it to another machine. Extend the existing Steel browser plugin scope to evaluate and, where supported, integrate browser-use/jev-ultrafast as an optional browser-agent layer over the existing Steel CDP endpoint. Preserve the existing Steel service and plugin behavior, keep credentials out of repository state, and document any unsupported direct integration as an explicit limitation.

sizeDecision.reason: Keep as one because the project isolation, engine routing, UI, and Steel lifecycle form one installable plugin capability and splitting now would leave the requested end-to-end behavior unshippable.
